newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HOIU LIISING PLANS LATVIA EXPANSION.
newsitem.headline: HOIU LIISING PLANS LATVIA EXPANSION.

text.p: Hoiupank Liising, the leasing arm of second-largest bank Hoiupank, said on Wednesday that it was planning expansion into the neighbouring Baltic states.
"We have fixed a plan to go to Latvia in September," Andres Eesmaa, chairman of the company, told a news conference.
He added that like the whole Hoiupank group, a serious analysis of the Ukrainian market was also taking place.
But he said that to enter the Lithuanian market, the company would probably finance projects from Estonia whereas in Latvia it would launch its own subsidiary.
Eesmaa added that the decision about the Ukrainian market depended on the plans of Hoiupank.
Hoiupank Liising is the second largest leasing company in Estonia and has a 14 percent market share, which it plans to grow to 20 percent this year.
